changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.comment: Merge PRS dbt ADS assets and fixed reports into one grouped catalog, and split wide ADS previews into focused table reports.
changeSet.sql: WITH primary_mapping(template_code, group_name, output_columns) AS ( VALUES ('PRS-FLOWERBIZ-OVERVIEW', 'PRS 租赁经营总览', '["年份","业务月份","项目","客户","业务大类","报花单数","在途单数","租金净额","处理成本","销售金额","额外费用"]'::jsonb), ('PRS-FLOWERBIZ-LEASE-EXECUTION', 'PRS 租赁报花执行', '["年份","业务月份","项目","客户","报花单数","换花单数","加摆单数","撤摆单数","调花单数","租金净额全口径","处理成本全口径"]'::jsonb), ('PRS-FLOWERBIZ-FINANCE-COST', 'PRS 销售坏账与费用', '["年份","业务月份","项目","客户","销售金额全口径","坏账成本全口径","含税金额合计","成本费用合计"]'::jsonb), ('PRS-FLOWERBIZ-CURING-WORKLOAD', 'PRS 养护人工作量', '["年份","业务月份","养护人","业务大类","经手单数","已结束单数","在途单数","租金净额全口径","处理成本全口径","销售金额全口径"]'::jsonb), ('PRS-FLOWERBIZ-PENDING-APPROVAL', 'PRS 在途审批与操作', '["报花单号","标题","业务类型","状态","项目","客户","申请人","养护人","申请时间","已挂起天数","是否超期"]'::jsonb), ('PRS-FLOWERBIZ-PROJECT-CUSTOMER', 'PRS 项目客户经营', '["年份","业务月份","项目","客户","报花单数","租赁单数","销售单数","租金净额","销售金额","坏账成本","额外费用"]'::jsonb), ('PRS-FLOWERBIZ-CHANGE-BOARD', 'PRS 变更与租期调整', '["变更单号","报花单号","项目","客户","报花业务类型","变更类型","变更状态","申请人","申请时间","确认人","确认耗时天数","金额差额"]'::jsonb), ('PRS-FLOWERBIZ-RECOVERY-BOARD', 'PRS 回收撤摆与去向', '["报花单号","项目","客户","回收类型","回收状态","绿植名","实际或计划回收数","回收成本金额","回收人","入库库房","业务月份"]'::jsonb), ('PRS-FLOWERBIZ-DRILL-LEASE-DETAIL', 'PRS 报花单明细', '["报花单号","业务类型","状态","项目","客户","摆位","绿植名","规格","数量","行租金合计","行成本合计","业务时间","养护人"]'::jsonb), ('PRS-FLOWERBIZ-DRILL-CHANGE-DETAIL', 'PRS 变更明细', '["变更单号","报花单号","项目","客户","变更类型","变更状态","变更数量","申请人","申请时间","确认人","金额差额","起租期变化天数","是否更换绿植"]'::jsonb), ('PRS-FLOWERBIZ-DRILL-RECOVERY-DETAIL', 'PRS 回收明细', '["报花单号","项目","客户","回收类型","回收状态","绿植名","计划回收数","实际回收数","回收成本金额","配送人","回收人","入库库房","业务月份"]'::jsonb), ('PRS-FLOWERBIZ-DRILL-AUDIT-TRAIL', 'PRS 审批操作链路', '["报花单号","业务类型","项目","客户","状态","操作动作","操作分类","操作人","操作时间","距上一步天数"]'::jsonb) ) UPDATE analytics_report_template t SET spec_json = jsonb_set( jsonb_set( jsonb_set( COALESCE(NULLIF(t.spec_json, '')::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb), '{assetKind}', to_jsonb('DBT_SCREEN_TABLE'::text), true ), '{assetGroup}', jsonb_build_object('code', m.template_code, 'name', m.group_name, 'role', 'PRIMARY'), true ), '{queryContract,outputColumns}', m.output_columns, true )::text, updated_at = ${now} FROM primary_mapping m WHERE t.template_code = m.template_code AND t.archived = false;

changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.comment: Add focused PRS report assets backed by existing dbt ADS models; these replace duplicate dbt-vs-fixed report entries with child reports under one asset group.

('PRS-FLOWERBIZ-PROJECT-CUSTOMER-TOP', 'PRS 项目经营 TOP', '从项目客户经营 ADS 拆出项目、客户、租金和销售贡献 TOP。', 'PRS-FLOWERBIZ-PROJECT-CUSTOMER', 'PRS 项目客户经营', '项目客户-TOP', 'public.xycyl_ads_flowerbiz_project_customer', 'PRS-FLOWERBIZ-PENDING-APPROVAL', 'PRS 在途审批与操作', '审批-耗时', 'public.xycyl_ads_flowerbiz_audit_trail', '["报花单号","业务类型","项目","客户","状态","操作动作","操作分类","操作人","操作时间","距上一步天数"]'::jsonb, '距上一步天数') ) INSERT INTO analytics_report_template ( name, description, spec_json, template_code, domain, category, data_source_type, target_object, refresh_policy, permission_policy_json, parameter_schema_json, metric_definition_json, presentation_schema_json, certification_status, version_no, published, archived, creator_id, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT s.name, s.description, jsonb_build_object( 'templateCode', s.template_code, 'reportType', 'fixed-table', 'displayType', 'table', 'assetKind', 'DBT_SPLIT', 'assetGroup', jsonb_build_object( 'code', s.group_code, 'name', s.group_name, 'parentTemplateCode', s.group_code, 'role', 'DETAIL' ), 'queryContract', jsonb_build_object( 'sourceType', 'DBT_ADS', 'targetObject', s.primary_model, 'primaryDbtModel', s.primary_model, 'dbtModels', jsonb_build_array(s.primary_model), 'outputColumns', s.output_columns, 'orderBy', jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('column', s.order_column, 'direction', 'desc')) ), 'placeholderReviewRequired', false )::text, s.template_code, 'PRS租赁', s.category, 'DBT_ADS', s.primary_model, 'DBT_BUILD', '{"scope":"DTS_DBT_ADS","classification":"INTERNAL"}', '{"params":[{"name":"dateFrom","type":"date","label":"开始日期","default":"2025-05-01"},{"name":"dateTo","type":"date","label":"结束日期"},{"name":"projectName","type":"string","label":"项目"},{"name":"customerName","type":"string","label":"客户"}]}', jsonb_build_object( 'metrics', s.output_columns, 'primaryDbtModel', s.primary_model, 'assetGroupCode', s.group_code )::text, '{"primary":"table","layout":"fixed-report-table","visualization":"bi-only","assetKind":"DBT_SPLIT"}', 'CERTIFIED', 1, true, false, 1, ${now}, ${now} FROM split s WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM analytics_report_template t WHERE t.template_code = s.template_code );
